visual_checks.evidence: The three ordered boxplots and every observation expose dose-related distribution shifts, spread, overlap and the high Low-dose observation. Group names decode colors directly.

Actual SVG has 36 colored circle instances, 12 per group. Exported circle paths have radius 2 pt (4 pt diameter); minimum within-group center distance is approximately 4.3 pt, leaving the adopted 0.3 pt edge gap.
Observation instances use fill only without stroke. Boxes have light fills and group-colored quartile boundaries; dark medians and whiskers remain clear as intentional summary line encodings.
Vehicle, Low dose, High dose left to right; Signal (a.u.) axis with regular 70-140 ticks. No missing glyphs, truncation or overlap visible.
Blue, orange and teal circles are distinct against light box fills. Dark medians remain visible; faint gridlines stay behind boxes and circles, and data occupy the primary panel area.

Actual PDF rendered at 96 dpi, approximately 454 by 341 pixels for 120 by 90 mm. Group labels, value ticks and y-axis label remain readable; individual dots are visible. This is a proportion check rather than a calibrated physical print.

No in-image title, panel identifier, narrative, count or extra legend. Separate caption provides units, technical-read aggregation, missing-read handling, box/whisker definitions, inference method and limitations.
